workflow.name: ChronicleAI Paid Onchain Watch
workflow.description: Free-tier Marketplace workflow: create the Watch audit record on Ethereum Sepolia, then send the successful transaction through ChronicleAI's Telegram ingest bridge for asynchronous registration and monitoring. Payment is handled by KeeperHub Marketplace on Base Mainnet.
workflow.marketplaceDescription: Start a paid ChronicleAI Watch campaign. Before calling, open @chronicleai_bot, send /start, and paste the one-time binding code returned by the bot. The code expires after 30 minutes and is required for Telegram alerts. KeeperHub handles payment on Base Mainnet; ChronicleAI creates the Watch audit record on Ethereum Sepolia and monitors it asynchronously. This workflow uses the free-tier Telegram bridge instead of HTTP Request actions.

telegramBindingCode.description: One-time code returned by @chronicleai_bot after /start; expires after 30 minutes.

startsAtUnix.description: Campaign start timestamp in Unix seconds.

endsAtUnix.description: Campaign end timestamp in Unix seconds.

watchSpecHash.description: Keccak-256 hash of the canonical Watch specification.
